ari_cs: Quick heads-up — Oaktree Health sandbox CPU-backed traces show p95 jumping from 240ms -> 420ms after the latest app deploy. No errors, just latency creep. Thinking proactive perf optimization: recommend an int8->int4 quant pilot + region-weighted routing to take pressure off us-east. Want to propose a 1% canary for 48h and a roll-back window.

sheila_se: Can you share the distribution/sample request logs? any change in token counts or burstiness?

ari_cs: Paste of recent hist (last 2k reqs):
```
p50: 110ms
p90: 210ms
p95: 420ms
mean: 165ms
avg tokens: 52
burst windows: 8 spikes/hr
```
No change in avg tokens; spikes align with batch job at 03:00 UTC.

mike_mle: Quick read — int4 looks promising for their, non-adversarial prompts. We should run evals on their 300-case medical prompt set first (sensitivity to numeric precision matters). If eval delta < 0.5% F1 / semantic drift, OK to canary. Also suggest enabling prefix KV caching for repeated greeting prompts.

sheila_se: Agree on safety checks. Proposed plan:
- Run offline eval (300 cust prompts) on `gptx-compact-int4` vs baseline (3h job).
- If pass, create canary: 1% traffic -> `gptx-compact-int4` in us-west-2 for 48h.
- Route fallback policy: if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > baseline+150ms for 30m, auto-failover to baseline.
- Add autoscaling headroom 20% for canary.

ari_cs: I'll ask Oaktree for sign-off today — they prefer low risk. I'll also capture 50 manual evals from their SME for edge cases.

mike_mle: For routing tweak: set region affinity to prefer us-west-2 for compact model, but keep global fallback. Suggest config snippet: 
```
routing_policy: {
  primary_region: "us-west-2",
  fallback_regions: ["us-east-1"],
  latency_threshold_ms: 150,
  error_threshold_pct: 0.5
}
canary: { traffic_pct: 1, duration_h: 48 }
```

redwood-deploy-bot: Canary created: id=cny-2026-041, model=gptx-compact-int4, traffic=1%, region=us-west-2, expires=48h

sheila_se: Nice. Also enable token-level cost and latency tracing for that canary so we have per-token breakdown. Set retention to 30d.

ari_cs: Will do. Scheduling enablement call w/ Oaktree for tomorrow 10am PT. I'll send the agenda (eval criteria + rollback checklist).

sheila_se: Nice. After 24h we should snapshot quality metrics and loop in support if any regressions.

mike_mle: One more thing — include a quick ablation: run quantized model with `kv_cache=true` vs `false` on 50 queries; caching reduces tail significantly for their traffic pattern.

ari_cs: noted. I'll add that to the job. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

redwood-deploy-bot: Canary status update (12h): p50 +8ms, p95 -40ms vs baseline on canary traffic, no errors observed.

sheila_se: Early signs look good. Keep monitoring and hold the renewal touchpoint until canary completes.

ari_cs: Copy — will capture customer sentiment in the enablement notes and add recommendation for a staged quant rollout if final eval passes. :white_check_mark:
